title: Release proposal and approval gate
objective: Respect repository release policy or propose SemVer, Breaking Changes, CHANGELOG, and Release Notes, then require explicit approval before Tag/Release creation.
acceptance_criteria: Existing release policy wins; otherwise propose SemVer from Conventional Commits.
Show proposed version, breaking changes, changelog, and release notes for approval.
Tag/Release creation always requires explicit approval; non-interactive returns approval_required.
undo_classification: Do not publish tags/releases without explicit approval.
retry_policy: Initial attempt plus at most 2 retries for local processing; remote mutation retries require fresh idempotency checks.
